brief:
Israeli lawmakers on Tuesday elected Matan Kahana as parliament speaker, Middle East Eye reported. Kahana is aligned with Gadi Eisenkot, a political rival to caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, marking a setback for the premier in the Knesset.

The election reflects a shift in parliamentary power, with lawmakers from Netanyahu's opposition camp taking control of the influential post as coalition talks loom.
dek: Israeli parliament elects Eisenkot ally as speaker in blow for Netanyahu Israeli lawmakers on Tuesday elected Matan Kahana, a parliament speaker from the camp opposed to caretaker prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
title: Israeli parliament elects Netanyahu opponent as speaker
